subject: 现存三门
author: Zairon
source_note: 实拍展示现存1425年山门的完整正面；图版省略前方低矮栏杆与周围景物。
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: Fanggu heritage line plate. Image 1 is a documentary photograph of the ACTUAL extant Tofuku-ji Sanmon in Kyoto, completed 1425; use it for architectural geometry. Image 2 is ONLY the project's delicate fine black ink style sample, NOT a building-shape reference. Draw the complete two-storey five-bay three-passage Zen temple gate, with its wide tiled upper and lower roofs, broad open ground level, white end-wall infills, thin timber posts and roof brackets. Match the straight-on facade and overall proportions in Image 1 while omitting trees, sky, people, low front fence and neighboring buildings. Refined sparse black ink contour drawing, fine neutral lines and restrained internal structure, no dark fills. Landscape 1536x1024; entire gate centered, about 82% width, roof and base uncut. Perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas outside and inside open passages. No shadow, gradient, paper grain, haze, checkerboard, color, text, symbols, frame or watermark.
